sliverDefect.finding: LAYOUT BUG, not a component failure.
sliverDefect.mechanism: web/property-map.html's #pm-panel (the search-result aside) carried no `hidden` of its own -- only its child <section>s did -- so it always claimed its fixed flex:0 0 340px inside .pm-layout even with nothing to show. At the ~380px rail width (--sc-rail, web/shell.css) that left #pm-map a few pixels.
sliverDefect.rejectedMechanism: A Leaflet invalidateSize/stale-container-size failure. Rejected because the effect is a plain CSS flex-basis computation, reproducible on first paint with zero resize or map interaction involved, and the live-measured sliver width (40px at 380px viewport) matches the arithmetic prediction (380 - 340 = 40) essentially exactly -- a stale Leaflet size would not track a CSS change this precisely, and the same box-model effect is measurable with Leaflet entirely absent from consideration.
sliverDefect.fix: web/property-map.js sets a pm-embedded class on <body> when window.self !== window.top; web/property-map.css hides #pm-panel and this page's own header/search/status chrome under that class. A direct, non-embedded visit to /property-map.html is unchanged.
sliverDefect.liveVerification: Playwright headless Chromium against the live deployed URL, both paths, at 380px/378px width -- see probe artifact ids sliver-defect-standalone-unfixed-path and sliver-defect-embedded-fixed-path.
